Everything else is fine, but when it comes to refunds and resolving delivery issues, there is far too much hassle for the customer.

Recently, we ordered several products from you. One of the products was marked as non-returnable/non-refundable, but the size delivered was different from what we ordered. We immediately raised a complaint.

First, the customer care team refused to help, saying that the product was non-returnable. Then we were asked to send an email along with photos. After that, we received a response saying that an inquiry was being conducted.

Even after 15–30 days, the customer has to keep chasing your team, repeatedly sending emails and following up for a resolution.

A BIG WHY?

If the mistake is from your side and the wrong product/size has been delivered, why should the customer have to go through so much trouble?

Please look at how other e-commerce companies handle such issues. The customer should not have to spend weeks chasing customer care for a mistake made by the seller.

We are experiencing a similar issue with JioMart as well. This raises a genuine question:

Is Reliance really reliable when it comes to customer service and resolving genuine complaints?

Please look into this matter seriously and resolve the issue at the earliest.

Thank you.

I placed my first order on 9th July, and the app clearly mentioned that it would be delivered within 2 days. However, I waited for 10 days, and the order was still not delivered. After multiple follow-ups with customer care, the order was finally cancelled, and my refund was processed. Unfortunately, the coupon I had used was also lost. One of your customer care representatives assured me that if I placed a fresh order, it would be delivered without any issues.

Trusting that assurance, I placed the same order again. This time, the products were marked under Rush Delivery, promising delivery within 4 hours. Surprisingly, even after waiting for 2 days, the order was not delivered. Once again, I had to contact customer care, raise a complaint, and eventually the order was cancelled with another refund.

Believing it might have been an isolated issue, I placed a third order with the same products. Unfortunately, the exact same problem has occurred again.

This is completely unacceptable. Advertising Rush Delivery and repeatedly failing to deliver the products is misleading and creates false expectations for customers. If AJIO cannot fulfil the promised delivery timelines, it should not display “Rush Delivery” on those products.

Customers should not have to waste their time placing the same order repeatedly, following up with customer care, and waiting for refunds. This experience has caused unnecessary inconvenience, frustration, and loss of trust in AJIO’s service.

As a customer, I would strongly advise others to think twice before ordering from AJIO. My recent experience with their return and refund process has been extremely frustrating and has raised serious concerns about their overall reliability and customer service standards.

Despite following the proper procedure and raising a return request within the stipulated time, the entire process has been unnecessarily delayed. Even after the product was successfully picked up, the refund has turned into a never-ending wait. There have been no clear updates, timelines, or accountability from their end. This kind of uncertainty leaves customers in a helpless position, constantly following up without receiving any concrete resolution.

What makes the situation worse is the nature of customer support. The responses provided are largely generic, repetitive, and do not address the actual issue. It appears as though there is little to no genuine effort to resolve customer grievances. Requests for clarification, escalation, or supporting evidence behind their decisions are either ignored or inadequately handled. This reflects a concerning lack of transparency in their internal processes.

From a legal standpoint, such practices raise serious concerns. Once a product has been returned and accepted by the company, an unreasonable delay in processing refunds, without valid justification, may amount to deficiency in service. Furthermore, denying or delaying legitimate claims without proper explanation or evidence may fall within the scope of unfair trade practices under applicable consumer protection laws. Businesses are expected to act in good faith, maintain transparency, and ensure timely redressal of customer complaints — failing which they may be held accountable.

It increasingly feels like once the payment is made, retrieving your money becomes unnecessarily complicated. This is not just an inconvenience but a significant breach of trust between the customer and the platform. In today’s competitive e-commerce environment, where other platforms manage to process refunds promptly after pickup, such delays appear arbitrary and unjustified.

Overall, my experience has been disappointing and stressful, especially when reliability is expected from a well-known platform. I would not recommend ordering from AJIO if you are expecting a smooth return process or dependable customer support. Customers should be cautious and aware of their rights when dealing with such situations.

Worst Customer Service I’ve Experienced - 10 Days of Harassment for a Simple Return

I am extremely disappointed with Nykaa and their complete lack of accountability after a sale.

I ordered a playpen for my 6-month-old baby. After delivery, I found that the playpen was too large to fit in my living room. The product is unused, in its original condition, and fully eligible for return, so I immediately raised a return request.

It has now been 10 days, and my return is still unresolved. During these 10 days, I have been calling Nykaa’s customer care twice every single day. Every conversation ends with the same robotic response: “Please wait 24–48 hours,” “Our team is looking into it,” or “We’ll escalate the issue.” Nothing has actually happened. No pickup. No resolution. No callback. No ownership.

The most frustrating part is that customers are expected to keep chasing Nykaa for a problem that should have been resolved days ago. Why should a customer spend hours on calls every day just to get a legitimate return processed? Is this the level of after-sales service Nykaa believes is acceptable?

As parents of a 6-month-old baby, we already have enough responsibilities. Instead of focusing on my child, I’ve been forced to waste my time repeatedly calling customer care, only to hear the same meaningless assurances. This is not customer service—this is harassment through delays and false promises.

Nykaa seems to be very efficient at selling products but completely irresponsible when it comes to supporting customers after payment has been made. The company has failed to provide even the most basic level of service by arranging a simple return pickup.

I deeply regret purchasing this product from Nykaa. This experience has completely shattered my trust in the brand. If this is how customers are treated after making a purchase, I will think many times before ordering from Nykaa again, and I certainly cannot recommend it to friends or family.

To anyone planning to buy bulky or expensive products from Nykaa, be extremely cautious. If something goes wrong, be prepared for endless follow-ups, scripted responses, and absolutely no accountability.

Nykaa, stop giving customers generic responses and start taking responsibility. A 10-day pending return with no resolution is completely unacceptable.

And to enhance the experience —the delivered product wasn't even the item I had ordered.

Now, despite raising a return, Nykaa has failed to honour the promised return approval timeline as well.

It's disappointing to see such a complete breakdown of customer service—from missed delivery commitments to ignored cancellation requests, wrong product delivery, and delayed returns. This is far below the level of professionalism one expects from a brand like Nykaa.
